title: What's On Guide – square images
slide_intent: Teach designers how to fit an alternative image proportion into a familiar publication series so its identity survives the change.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can use square photographs across quarterly covers while retaining the same title and navigational cues.
demonstration: The three quarterly covers repeat the pink, blue and green grounds. Centered square images leave visible color on either side beneath the title.
practical_value: Choose this treatment when the subject works better in a square crop and preserve enough margin around the image to make the format intentional.

content_islands.name: Shared masthead
content_islands.spec: Across three portrait covers, align the quarter, circular seal and large white What’s On title.

content_islands.name: Square-photo treatment
content_islands.spec: Center one square photo below each title with color visible on all sides. Fit the venue list, entry information and website into the remaining area at the foot.
